recommended_action: Investigate immediately — resource should not be discharging at negative prices with minimal stored energy.
Review — may be intentional (AS obligation or ramp constraint) but warrants verification.
Verify whether charge is from an AS award or a bidding error.
Stora may have failed to submit. Check Stora logs and resubmit manually if needed.
Resource is non-compliant. Check plant status, communications, and inverter faults.
ISO may have stale parameters. File ticket to update resource limits.
May indicate metering drift or unexpected cycling.
Alert asset manager — may need to curtail to protect warranty.
Review DA market results - award exceeds submitted bid by >10%. Verify no data entry error in bid submission. Check if ISO applied must-offer adjustments.
